title: Club shirts mostly good. This one not so much.
text: Been a subscription member for a few months, 2 mens sizes and 2 women. Most prints are good but this Undertaker shirt is very pixilated. Disappointing because... UNDERTAKER!! Would have loved this shirt to represent the image better. All the shirts are pretty good quality, classic fit for the mens shirts. A bit blocky, wish there was a modern fit option for men. The Women's shirts run small by a full size. Overall happy with the club and shirts so far.
label: neutral
